source.title: Munda cognate set with proto-Munda reconstructions
source.creator: Felix Rau
source.conference_context: 8th International Conference on Austroasiatic Linguistics (ICAAL 8), Chiang Mai, 29-31 August 2019

source_reported_scope.description: Zenodo states that the dataset contains 127 cognates with proto-Munda reconstructions and references to MKCD and Pinnow (1959).

stable_keys_checked: title:munda cognate set with proto-munda reconstructions
deduplication.search_index_caveat: GitHub code-search responses were marked incomplete_results=true; therefore absence from indexed code search is not sufficient for permanent identity assignment.

rights_and_cultural_access.decision: Promote exact repository identity, scope and file/checksum locator metadata only. Do not ingest cognate rows until item licence and row-level provenance/rights boundaries are resolved.

blockers: Rendered Zenodo record exposes a Rights/License heading but did not expose a machine-readable licence value in this retrieval path.
Dataset bytes were not acquired, so the repository-reported MD5 has not been independently recomputed.
Row-level references/provenance and any rights inherited from MKCD or Pinnow (1959) require inspection before lexical-content ingestion.
Permanent MMSC identity assignment awaits deterministic reconciliation against all non-indexed branch discovery records, not only incomplete GitHub code search.
release_value: Moves the Rau 2019 candidate from generic discovery to exact DOI/version/file/hash-locator audit without fabricating licence, checksum verification, lexical evidence or source counts.
